title: Delivery receipt is agent state transition, not pane-text needle
action: Per D1: deliver_pointer's receipt becomes a state check — after each pointer send, poll a status closure (agent_status by job_id) plus a result-present closure (round-1 result file) for up to a short per-attempt window (~5s at POLL_INTERVAL steps); Some("working")|Some("done") or result present = delivered; idle past the window = resend. Drop the pane-text needle receipt (pane_text stays only if another caller needs it; remove if dead). Keep POINTER_DELIVERY_ATTEMPTS=30 bounded attempts, injected sleep/clock seams, exhaustion error message updated to name the state receipt. Update execute_new/continue call sites and tests: echo-false-positive regression test — a status that stays idle while pane text contains the needle must NOT count as delivered; a status flip to working on attempt N delivers.

truths: Receipt is agent_status working/done or round-result presence, never pane text
Idle past the per-attempt window resends; 30 bounded attempts

trace.outcome: Delivery receipt reads agent state; pane-text needle receipt removed

report.outcome: Delivery receipt reads agent state (working/done or round result present); pane-text needle receipt removed; FakeHerdr models the post-prompt working flip; echo-false-positive regression test added
